as_told.title: Karl Nell on the Sed festival and the Egyptian magical papyri

plain: The idea is that the Pyramid Texts, the ancient Egyptian religious writings carved inside royal pyramids, were not only funeral spells but the script of an initiation, built around the Sed festival, a known Egyptian kingship ritual, so that the pyramid and its texts together worked as what he calls "an initiatic engine". A researcher named Karl Nell lays this out on the show without naming a source; if he is right, the pyramids were places where living people went through a transforming rite. Michels later passes the idea on himself in another episode, crediting Nell and adding the Egyptian magical papyri and "secret brotherhoods in Egypt".
